subject: en_guided
source: English National Curriculum — English programmes of study: key stages 1 and 2 (lower KS2, Year 4), DfE 2013 — reading comprehension, taught through VIPERS guided reading skills

weeks.topic: Fluency: expressive reading of a class novel opening
objectives: Read aloud with pace, pauses and expression
Discuss how fluency helps understanding

weeks.topic: Retrieve: skimming and scanning information texts on Ancient Egypt
objectives: Skim for the main idea
Scan for specific facts and dates

weeks.topic: Vocabulary: using prefixes and roots to work out meanings
objectives: Use prefixes and root words to work out meanings
Check meanings in a dictionary

weeks.topic: Infer: characters' thoughts in historical fiction
objectives: Infer what characters think but do not say
Support inferences with quotations

weeks.topic: Predict: using stated and implied details
objectives: Predict events from stated and implied details
Explain the clues used

weeks.topic: Explain: how authors describe settings
objectives: Explain how description builds a picture of a setting
Discuss the effect on the reader

weeks.topic: Summarise: main ideas across several paragraphs
objectives: Identify the main idea of several paragraphs
Write a summary in your own words

weeks.topic: Retrieve: diagrams and labels in explanation texts
objectives: Retrieve information from labelled diagrams

weeks.topic: Vocabulary: technical vocabulary in science texts

objectives: Explain how poets create images

weeks.topic: Summarise: a myth in 50 words
objectives: Pick out the essential events of a myth

weeks.topic: Vocabulary: words with multiple meanings in adventure fiction
objectives: Identify words with more than one meaning
Use context to choose the right meaning

weeks.topic: Predict: from a chapter cliffhanger

Justify predictions with evidence

weeks.topic: Explain: how authors build tension

objectives: Explain how techniques such as exaggeration persuade

objectives: Identify formal and informal vocabulary
Explain why writers choose each

Read a scene aloud to show them

objectives: Explain how a discussion text is organised
Identify the conclusion and its reasons

Decide which is more accurate and why

objectives: Recommend a book to a group
Justify opinions with examples

objectives: Answer questions on all VIPERS skills

objectives: Reflect on strongest and weakest VIPERS skills
